description: This file defines a custom implementation of the DataTransfer interface, named MyDataTransfer, which manages data transfer formats for drag-and-drop operations. It handles setting, clearing, and retrieving data with support for normalized formats, with some methods unimplemented.

classes.name: MyDataTransfer
classes.description: A custom implementation of the DataTransfer interface for managing data formats during drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets data for a specified format after normalizing the format name.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data for a specified format or all data if no format is specified.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specified format, returning an empty string if none exists.

methods.name: get normalized format function
methods.description: Normalizes format strings to handle common cases like 'text' and 'url'.
